notes.title: Neverland officially launches English version
notes.notes:
Thanks to the unremitting efforts of the English localization staff, proofreaders and me, Neverland has finally updated the English version!
Due to engine limitations, it is very regrettable that the English version cannot be switched inside the game. Also, due to the high difficulty of multi-language localization, other languages ​​cannot be made. Thank you for your support!

By the way, I wish you all a happy Valentine's Day!
